name: get_view
description: Use this as the primary tool to get a specific view on a log bucket. Log views provide fine-grained access control to the logs in your buckets.

name.description: Required. The resource name of the policy: "projects/[PROJECT_ID]/locations/[LOCATION_ID]/buckets/[BUCKET_ID]/views/[VIEW_ID]" For example: `"projects/my-project/locations/global/buckets/my-bucket/views/my-view"`
